notes.title: Update v1.4.0 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're alive! As we recently brought Dollhouse to... another PC store platform ;), we found that there were still some things in the game that needed fixing. That's why we're bringing a one-off new patch here to the game on Steam as well!

This update focuses on fixing some nasty bugs that were still in the game. Here's a full list!

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the second track "The moon is blue" was not audible in the game after track is switched
[*]Fixed an issue where button text overlapped
[*]Fixed an issue where death mask item in mannequin augmented in the journal, had placeholder thumbnail
[*]Fixed an issue where equipping one or two passive abilities did not complete the 'Equip 2 abilities' quest
[*]Fixed an issue where after respawning the flash light charge level was not full
[*]Fixed an issue where texts got cut off on different show timing boards due to wall texture in chapter 2
[*]Fixed an issue where player was able to assign 'Windows' and 'Num Lock' keys in the Controls Key binding section
[*]Fixed an issue where player fails to progress further if they stabbed bodies more than the required amount in Chapter 4
[*]Fixed an issue where burst SFX was not audible after players analyzed any game asset
[*]Fixed an issue where ability unnecessarily got triggered if player pressed 'RT' to use Flash during gameplay
[*]Fixed an issue where players could not pick up extracted memory from Skill share station on Chapter 6
[*]Fixed an issue where wall texture was missing at the door present in the lost room of the 3rd Chapter
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability points were displayed in negative value during lost room of Chapter 4
[*]Fixed an issue where the enlighten ability unlocked more than once after progressing
[/list]
If you encounter any other issues since this patch, please don't hesitate to reach out through the Steam Community Hub!

-Marten

notes.title: THE FAREWELL PARTY IS NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5705637/bc5aae8f23e645a56200e275f8fb8f10398f30ab.jpg[/img]

The time has come. The final major update for Dollhouse has arrived. It was quite a journey, we would like to thank the community for their amazing support that allowed us to keep going for this long. We hope you guys enjoy this update!

[i]Version 1.2.9
[/i]

[b]FAREWELL PARTY
[/b]
This update overhauls various aspects of the Multiplayer mode in our game and other QoL updates. This update serves as a bookend to our multiplayer mode with a few new additions.

[b]GENERAL GAMEPLAY UPDATE
[/b]
Multiplayer Additions
[list]
[*] Added  “Murder Party” costumes for all Nominees. These are the corrupted variants of each playable Nominee
[*] Updated Splashes for new costumes for all Nominees.
[*] Added Enhancement card customization for each Nominee, these are minor buffs players can further customize their characters with to suit their play styles
[*] Updated the Menus for the Nominee Selection and MP Lobby to support the Enhancement cards
[/list]
Multiplayer Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the dropped connection does not clean up properly
[*] Reduced the minimum number of players to two instead of three
[/list]
Singleplayer Additions
[list]
[*] Music Vinyls collected in the game can now be used to customize the default soundtrack for all Safe Room music. Players are no longer restricted to only listening to the tracks in the Main Menu
[*] Added Vinyl Player to every Safe Room
[/list]

[b]GENERAL GAMEPLAY FIXES
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Vinyl placement issues so Vinyl pickups are now tracked
[*] Fixed an issue that caused dialogues to be cut off after the final boss fight
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the recording station to not play idle SFX
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the recording station to not account for pause during playback
[*] Fixed an issue that caused part 2 chase initialization SFX to play in part 1
[*] Fixed an issue that caused fade shader materials to not fade to transparent correctly
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the loadout to misbehave under certain conditions
[*] Attempted to remove the flickering of abilities when MP stars in the centre HUD
[*] Updated MP loading screen so the "how to play" text has more room to display its contents
[/list]

[b]QoL UPDATES
[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed vinyl pickup in the tutorial to make it less confusing
[*] Added background to footer text in the Nominee selection screen to make the hotkeys more visible
[*] Updated various text instructions to standardize it and make it more clear
[*] Added icons beside the Modifier list in the pause menu to easier identity which modifier is enabled
[*] Updated the Pause Menu so it shows a chalk background when you select the chalk rather than a bottle to reduce confusion
[*] Removed the color from traps to keep it consistent with the rest of the threats in the game
[/list]
[IMPORTANT] Brightness Update

Updated the base brightness of the game and changed how the brightness calibration is calculated so the changes to brightness are more visible


This is our last Major Content update for Dollhouse. There will be one more patch coming sometime this week or early next week to fix any major outstanding bugs/ issues.

notes.title: DOLLHOUSE SURVIVAL GUIDE
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5705637/8bf78f5d3796b6d6db65d61f59c775e33f899ee3.jpg[/img]

[b]WALKTHROUGH[/b]

1.	Introducing the Survival Guide, a quick walkthrough to help you find your way through the darkness.

2.	Your Flashlight is one of your most valuable tools, press “F” to toggle it. Batteries don’t last forever. When your flashlight is off, movement will recharge it.

3.	Be quick and cautious! Use the Shift Key to run, but be careful to save your energy for when you need it.

4.	Mannequins are most dangerous when your back is turned. Each level will introduce a new type of Mannequin, and they have unique Augments which are meant to harm and confuse you. Flash them to fight back.

5.	Analyze helps you gather Evidence, but scanning something once isn’t enough. Make sure to Analyze as much as you can to better understand the Enemies and Traps you’re encountering. When you’ve gathered all possible evidence, Analyze will no longer be available for that subject.

6.	Use your Focus ability to see through the eyes of your pursuer. While Focused, you will be able to track Memories.

7.	To escape each level, you first need to gather Memories which are stored in Film Canisters. They are hidden throughout each chapter, and can be found by using Focus or through exploration.

8.	Once located, Memories are not viable in their current form. To use them, you need to extract them at a Memory Station. 

9.	Secure Memory Stations allow you to safely extract a Memory, grant Experience, and can be used to progress through the level. 

10.	Blacklist Stations will secure your Memory in exchange for Experience at a cost, the Memory footage will be blacklisted in the Picture Editor at the end of the level. 

11.	Skill Secure Stations will grant you the Skill shown at the station and secure your Memory but will not grant any Experience. 

12.	Secured Memories are used to open the Lost Room Door, and are available in the Cutting Room after you’ve completed each chapter.

13.	After you’ve secured Memories, you need to bring them to the Lost Room Door. You can bring several at a time if you wish.

14.	 The Lost Room will reveal the game It has planned for you. There is a hint to help you solve each puzzle. Win It’s game to collect the Master Key.
 
15.	A Beacon is available in the Lost Room, it will temporarily reveal all game pieces, including those that correspond to It’s game.

16.	Once you’ve collected the Master Key in the Lost Room, it’s time to locate the Dressing Room and solve the Script.

17.	Fixing the Script will be easier if you collected Fragments, which are short pieces of the Script found on the walls of each Chapter. Any collected Fragments will be solved, any missed will need to be assembled in the correct order to fix the Script.

18.	After you have fixed the Script, the present in the Dressing Room will be open and you can expose the version of It that has been pursuing you this Chapter.

19.	After you’ve left the Dressing Room, you need to run! It’s true identity has been revealed, and will do anything to stop you. Traps are active and dangerous. Find the Cutting Room (the door you entered the chapter from) and escape.

20.	After you’ve safely made it to the Cutting Room, you need to use the Memories you collected to create a new film sequence. 

21.	If you die along the way, you will need to retrace your steps to find the outline of your body and initiate a Playback. Your Playback will restore your lost progress.

[b]FAQ[/b]

This willl be updated soon!

notes.title: [ROSE'S DIAGNOSIS] Report #1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5705637/6fbc3b228912c37f1bfbec5de3fd8be5ca5c2021.jpg[/img]

[b]WHAT IS IT
[/b]

At the beginning of each week, we will outline what to expect from us as we are working to fix up and polish Dollhouse. We committed to working on Dollhouse until it's exactly where we want it to be!

[b]THIS WEEK’S CHECKUP
[/b]

We are focused on fixing all the major display issues present in Multiplayer HUD that affect players enjoyment, and other multiplayer issues preventing players from properly connecting. We are also looking into various QoL fixes now that all the known critical issues are resolved. Stay tuned for an important update tomorrow!

[b]MULTIPLAYER
[/b]

Murder Party is something we really wanted players to enjoy, but we understand that there are quite a few issues plaguing this mode. We plan to tackle most of the critical ones this week to better improve players experiences. We chose to keep Multiplayer in Beta at launch, until we could better address these issues.

Multiplayer Connection Issues

[list]
[*] There are a few players reporting that there are connection issues. We will be looking at the stability for this as fast as we can.
[/list]

Multiplayer Lobby Issues

[list]
[*] A few display issues and cases where the player’s character isn’t displaying properly in the Winner’s Screen
[*] Players stuck in an infinite connection screen attempting to reconnect
[/list]

Multiplayer Safe Issue

[list]
[*] A Rare bug where Rose will talk to the player as if they are still in the Cutting Room in singleplayer
[/list]

Multiplayer HUD

[list]
[*] A lot of general fixes to improve the QoL for players with proper information and less clutter
[/list]

[b]RESIDUAL TUTORIAL ISSUES
[/b]

Tutorial has come A LONG way since our Beta thanks to player feedback. There are still a few QoL fixes and additions we want to add.

[list]
[*] Objective Marker for the categories players need to go to when opening the pause menu
[*] Direct the player’s to the respective Memory Station tab upon first time using the stations
[*] Adding distance checks for the items and points of interest that players need to interact with
[/list]

[b]MOVIE EDITOR EXPLANATION
[/b]

We are looking at adding a tutorial-like sequence to this mechanic to better explain how it works, we understand it's pretty daunting at first glance.

[b]OPTIMIZATION[/b]

The “Lobby” level in our game is performing inconsistently with FPS dips. We are investigating this issue and hope to have it sorted out by the end of this patch.

[b]Z-FIGHTING PROJECTION ISSUE
[/b]

Multiple visual artifacts are showing up when there are 2D planes in the level while a Memory Station is on. We are looking into a solution to remove this completely

[b]MULTIPLE MONITOR DISPLAY
[/b]

We are attempting to figure an elegant way of supporting Multiple Monitor Displays.

[b]BUILD VERSIONS
[/b]

We are postponing the ports of the following builds until we fix all the major issues in our game. These builds will take time and we do not want to rush it:

[list]
[*] MAC
[*] LINUX
[*] 32-BIT
[/list]

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] CRITICAL BUG FIXES ON THE WAY
notes.notes:
To our community,

There were a few game breaking bugs that slipped through the cracks before it was launched and we will be resolving these issues ASAP hopefully be live by tomorrow latest. 

The following is a list of known issues that we will be tackling:

1. A RARE progression bug stopping players from completing the game at later levels
2. World going dark without resuming normal lighting after using a Memory Station
3. Mannequins don’t seem to attack/ less lethal at later levels
4. Adding a Missing Memory Count in the HUD
5. Align the Death Screen text & make it more obvious to the player what they lost

By Monday, we plan to fix a lot of the display issues wrong in Multiplayer and the inability to Focus properly.

We also plan to unveil an Official Milestone List of our internal plans early next week of the issues we will be tackling based on your honest feedback.

We’ve spent a long time working on Dollhouse and we DO NOT plan to let it go unfixed.

QA is not a perfect process, and as a team of just 12 members we are constantly working hard to bring our community the best version of Dollhouse possible. 

Please join the Soedesco Discord and visit the Dollhouse channel, or visit our Community on Steam to report any bugs you have encountered. This is the fastest method to get the reports directly to our team. 

-Creazn Studio
